$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — Air Ops 6b showcase, five vignettes. DEMO (golden false: five capabilities, a 300 s run). Judge (1) the bomb bursts within 25 m of (-400,-550) (two boxes, one per side of the burst), (2) the gun run fires 10+ rounds and the column lead dies, (3) the Apache fires and never comes within 300 m of its position (500,400), (4) the UH-60 circles within 550 m of the Orbit Truck, (5) its door guns fire and the Orbit Truck is destroyed. Left out: rockets AND gun (weaponIndex values unknown), 250 m inner ring and 'never hovering' (a speed), the left gunner shot and the orbit reversal (door gunners are unnamed 'Rifleman' seats). runFor 300 is the cap; the door-gun take ends at 330 s, so the truck's death may need longer.
